subject: general
question: Which of the following sports does NOT have its apex national governing body headquartered in New Delhi?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Volleyball Federation of India**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Volleyball Federation of India (VFI)** serves as the **governing body for volleyball **within the nation.
 
• Established in **1951,** it has been instrumental in fostering and managing volleyball events nationwide.
 
• Here are some key facets of the VFI:
 
• **Affiliation: **The VFI holds affiliation with the International Volleyball Federation (FIVB) and stands as a member of the Asian Volleyball Confederation.
 
• **Headquarters: **Situated in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, the VFI operates from its headquarters.
 
• President: Currently, Prof. Achyuta Samanta holds the position of president within the VFI. Inaugural President: Mr. F. C. Arora (from Punjab) served as the first president of the Volleyball Federation of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Athletics Federation of India (AFI)** holds the paramount position as the governing body for athletics in India. Established in 1946, the AFI is responsible for the administration and coordination of athletics throughout the nation, including the organization of national championships and the development of Indian athletes for international competitions.
 
• **The Badminton Association of India (BAI)** functions as the governing body for badminton in India. Established in 1934, BAI operates as an association registered under the societies act. Since its inception, BAI has been pivotal in organizing national-level badminton tournaments across India, with its first such event held in 1936.**​ **
